notes: Aggressive runner — confine to dedicated bed or containers. Cut hard mid-summer to refresh.

seasonalTasks.title: Remove mint flower spikes
seasonalTasks.body: Remove flower spikes as they appear to keep the leaves' flavor.

seasonalTasks.title: Divide mint if it is crowded
seasonalTasks.body: Divide the plants every 3 to 4 years to keep them vigorous.
